name: Cinco Noches en Lost and Found
summary:
Cinco Noches en Lost and Found is a fan-made first-person survival horror game created in celebration of the 10th anniversary of the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise.

Players take on the role of a temporal agent trapped inside a simulation they were supposed to monitor after a critical system failure. While waiting for the system to reboot, players must complete daily tasks while avoiding animatronic sentinels deployed by the security system, which recognizes them as an intrusion.

The game incorporates classic mechanics inspired by Scott Cawthon's series, including security camera monitoring, flashlight control, protective masks, and electroshock devices.
